method: Google News RSS (hl=en-US, gl=US), 2026-09-18..25: "Asheville" sliced per day with after:/before: (each query caps at 100), Google's Asheville geo section, and 14 when:7d searches for Buncombe towns, neighborhoods and institutions (county/city government, schools, police/sheriff, Mission, UNCA, Warren Wilson, A-B Tech, Helene). Stories deduped on publisher + headline (Google repeats one story under several ids). count = unique stories found; buncombeCount = those whose headline names a Buncombe place (same test as lib/news/sources/shared/buncombe.ts, plus "AVL"). mostlyOutsideBuncombe is judged from the outlet's home base and beat. Unknown national/other-region outlets default to true. module = the lib/news/sources file that reads this outlet directly, if any.
